what: A water-height shader covering the panel (hero). Two half-resolution height fields are drawn alternately every frame, spreading ripples by averaging the four neighbors and decaying by .96 each time. Mouse or finger strikes the water along its path with radius .06 (of the panel) and strength .35, so the looping video underneath (fit with cover) refracts and shimmers by ripple slope × .07. The background is --kf-contrast-bg with only .09 of the video mixed in, showing through very faintly, and an accent-colored glint (exponent 24) sits on the wave crests

options.radius: Water-strike radius (share of the board), default .06
options.mix: Video blend share, default .09 — 1 keeps the video as is
options.scale: Height field resolution (ratio to the panel), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Looping background video (muted autoplay loop playsinline) — without it, only the background color wave
options.host: Outer element that receives the mouse (css, nearest ancestor) — if text covers the panel, that section. Default is the parent

use: …
note: If the video is loaded from another origin (for example a page opened via file://), it tries drawing one frame and, if that fails, draws only a background-color ripple without video. The original reads a height field at 64×36 and ripples even the title text on top through an SVG displacement filter — here only the plate ripples. With reduced motion nothing is applied, leaving only the video (.09)

from.where: /  index.html .ag-hero__visual (Hero ripple — original water-ripple-canvas, damping .96 · radius .06 · strength .35 · refraction .07 · video .09 · background [.047,0,.18])
